The hearty meat in this mainstay dish leaves bellies satisfied all throughout Hyrule.|Recipe Book|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Meat Stews are [[Meal]]s that are made by [[Cooking]] either [[Raw Meat]] or a [[Raw Bird Drumstick]] with [[Tabantha Wheat]], [[Goat Butter]], and [[Fresh Milk]] in a [[Cooking Pot]]. When eaten, they will heal some of [[Link]]'s [[Heart]]s. These stews are mainstay dishes, containing hearty [[Meat]]s that leave people satisfied throughout [[Hyrule]]. By adding a fifth Ingredient to Meat Stew, Link can make one of the following variations: * '''Chilly Meat Stew''':{{Cite|{{Big|Chilly Meat Stew}}
Grants low-level heat resistance.
The hearty meat in this mainstay dish leaves bellies satisfied all throughout Hyrule.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding chilly Ingredients. Link can eat these stews to gain one level of [[Heat Resistance]]. * '''Electro Meat Stew''':{{Cite|{{Big|Electro Meat Stew}}
Grants low-level electricity resistance.
The hearty meat in this mainstay dish leaves bellies satisfied all throughout Hyrule.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding electric Ingredients. Link gains one level of [[Shock Resistance]] when he eats them. * '''Enduring Meat Stew''':{{Cite|{{Big|Enduring Meat Stew}}
Restores and overfills your Stamina Wheel.
The hearty meat in this mainstay dish leaves bellies satisfied all throughout Hyrule.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding an enduring Ingredient. Consuming them will completely restore and overfill Link's Stamina Wheel. * '''Energizing Meat Stew''':{{Cite|{{Big|Energizing Meat Stew}}
Instantly refills some of your Stamina Wheel.
The hearty meat in this mainstay dish leaves bellies satisfied all throughout Hyrule.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding an energizing Ingredient. If one of these stews are eaten, Link's Stamina Wheel will be partially refilled. * '''Hasty Meat Stew''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hasty Meat Stew}}
Grants a low-level movement-speed boost.
The hearty meat in this mainstay dish leaves bellies satisfied all throughout Hyrule.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding a hasty Ingredient. When eaten, they'll boost Link's movement speed. * '''Hearty Meat Stew''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hearty Meat Stew}}
Restores your health and temporarily increases your maximum hearts.
The hearty meat in this mainstay dish leaves bellies satisfied all throughout Hyrule.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding a hearty Ingredient. Eating them will heal all of Link's Hearts and increase his maximum Hearts. * '''Mighty Meat Stew''':{{Cite|{{Big|Mighty Meat Stew}}
Grants a low-level attack-power boost.
The hearty meat in this mainstay dish leaves bellies satisfied all throughout Hyrule.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding mighty Ingredients. If they are eaten, they will increase the power of Link's attacks. * '''Sneaky Meat Stew''':{{Cite|{{Big|Sneaky Meat Stew}}
Grants a low-level stealth boost.
The hearty meat in this mainstay dish leaves bellies satisfied all throughout Hyrule.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding sneaky Ingredients. When eaten, Link will gain a temporary boost to his [[Stealth]]. * '''Spicy Meat Stew''':{{Cite|{{Big|Spicy Meat Stew}}
Grants low-level cold resistance.
The hearty meat in this mainstay dish leaves bellies satisfied all throughout Hyrule.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding a spicy Ingredient. Eating these stews will grant Link one level of [[Cold Resistance]]. * '''Tough Meat Stew''':{{Cite|{{Big|Tough Meat Stew}}
Grants a low-level defense boost.
The hearty meat in this mainstay dish leaves bellies satisfied all throughout Hyrule.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding tough Ingredients. Eating these stews will increase Link's defense. ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Food * Gourmet Meat Stew * Meal * Prime Meat Stew }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Food, Health Restoring Items, Meals, Stews |items= BotW, TotK }}
